label_semantics: Folder taxonomy pairs 14 produce types with Healthy/Rotten labels. Source root names this a Diseases Dataset; no documentation establishes that “Rotten” is equivalent to Freshness ground truth. No official split exists; deterministic grouped 80/10/10 splits use seed 2048 after conflicting duplicate groups are held unresolved.
